Subtitle: Files between your PC and phone. Directly over your local network.
SecurityNote: Development preview: HTTP is not encrypted. Use a trusted private network. Keep Safari open during transfers.
NetworkLabel: Choose a network interface before starting sharing.
ServerMissing: Transfer server is missing. Build the solution or use the complete portable package.
ServerFailed: Could not start the transfer server. Check the selected interface and try again.
ConnectionLost: Connection to the local server was lost.
NoDevices: No devices yet. Scan the QR code with your phone.
LocalOnly: Local test mode. Choose a Wi-Fi or Ethernet address to connect a phone.
ScanQr: Scan this QR code on your phone. Approve the request here. QR codes expire after 10 minutes.
SelectRecipient: Connect and select a recipient first.
InvalidFile: Choose a file up to 10 GB.
ReadyForPhone: Files are ready for the selected phone to download.
DiagnosticHelp: This screen reads local interface information only. It does not test firewall rules or Wi-Fi client isolation. If your phone cannot connect, check both devices use the same local network, Windows firewall allows LAN Drop on the selected private/domain network, and guest Wi-Fi does not isolate clients. No network or firewall settings are changed.
NetworkBlocked: Sharing is blocked on Public or Unknown networks. Choose a trusted Private/Domain interface, or loopback for local testing.
